column4: Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text. The SAME woman with EXACTLY the same colours as the reference: the same sallow skin, blonde hair, red cap, gold hoops, the same furious scowl and the same open grin of sharp teeth with thick strings of drool. She is LUNGING straight at the camera out of the dark, seen from the chest up, her head thrust forward, and both of her arms are far too long, stretched straight at the viewer, the fingers splayed and much too long, thin and jointed wrong, with chipped red nails, the hands nearest the camera huge with perspective, almost touching the lens. Her hair flies back. Black hollow eyes with one tiny white point each. A horror game jump scare frame, uncanny and repulsive, not sexual.

Pixel-art overlay exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole middle, no text. ONLY her two hands, nothing else: the same woman's sallow skin, from the left edge and from the right edge of the frame two long thin hands reach in and grip, as if holding the head of whoever looks out of this picture: fingers far too long with an extra joint, knuckles swollen, chipped red nail polish, dirt and dried blood under the nails, the fingertips curling in towards the middle and digging in. The left hand enters from the left edge, the right hand from the right edge, wrists cut off at the edges; the middle of the frame stays empty magenta. Horror game first-person overlay, disgusting, not sexual.

Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text. The SAME woman's face in the same extreme close-up, the same red cap, blonde hair, gold hoops and sallow skin, but her whole head has SPLIT OPEN vertically down the middle from the forehead through the nose to the chin, like a second mouth: the two halves of her face pulled wide apart to the sides, each half still with its scowling eye staring at the camera, and both raw edges of the split lined with rows of long sharp teeth; inside the split wet dark red flesh, glistening tendons and a black throat going down, thick strings of drool and blood stretched across the gap. Body horror, morbid and repulsive, Loab-like nightmare, not sexual.

Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background only in the four corners, no text. The view from INSIDE her mouth as it closes over the camera: the frame is filled by her mouth opened impossibly wide, her stretched red lips at the very edges of the frame, and inside rings upon rings of long sharp teeth spiralling inwards into a wet black-red throat, a swollen tongue, thick strings of saliva and blood hanging across, the teeth nearest the camera huge and out of focus. Morbid body horror, the last thing you see, not sexual.

Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size, palette and lighting of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text. The SAME young woman as in the reference, the same red cap, blonde hair, black dress, red heels and sallow skin, standing full body, front view, feet at the bottom edge, perfectly still, but her head is twisted round on her neck so it is UPSIDE DOWN, chin at the top, the red cap hanging down, her long hair falling up past it, the grin of sharp teeth upside down with drool running UP her face; the skin of her neck twisted and torn into a spiral; her arms hanging far too long, the fingers past her knees, a little blood running down one leg. Uncanny, morbid, still, not sexual.
